assets.polygons: unmeasured, ~81.3MB raw — WAY over budget, see notes
assets.notes: ⚠️ TEKNİK BORÇ: Generated from the project owner's own reference image of a generic stock 3D dragon render (not an HBO/show screenshot — verified, no copyright concern from the source image itself). But at ~81MB this single asset alone blows the entire desktop texture-memory budget (<2GB total, this is >4% of it for ONE prop) many times over relative to its likely on-screen importance. MUST be decimated (target: <5MB, <20K triangles) and have its texture(s) downscaled/compressed before any real use — do not load as-is in game3d.js. Three near-duplicate variants exist (v1/v2/v3) from repeated generation attempts; only one is likely needed after decimation, the others are candidates for deletion once the best one is identified.
